name: cli-templates-show
body:
`kalide templates <name>` shows the template's fields (type, required, default, limits, formats, description), its sections — for a slide template the child sections it declares, and for a section template the child sections it can hold — each with the section templates it accepts and its min/max repeats, its body rules, and its example slide. A list field whose item is a record (record-item-type) shows the record's shape, including its nested fields. Unknown name = error with closest-match suggestion. `kalide templates <name>` prints a list-of-record field's nested fields indented beneath it (name, type, rules incl. nullable), recursively for nested records.

AC: `kalide templates <name>` prints a list-of-record field's nested fields indented beneath it — each nested field's name, type and rules including `nullable` — recursively for nested records.
